name: retailflow-saas
description: Multi-tenant retail POS, inventory and khata (credit ledger) platform for South Asian shops. Next.js 15 + Supabase Postgres with Row Level Security.
author: Ahmad Hassan <ahmad.hsn0099@gmail.com>

comments.overrides: next@15.5.21 pins sharp ^0.34.3, but sharp <0.35.0 carries high-severity inherited libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj), and next vendors a postcss <=8.5.17 with three more (GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 and friends). next/image is used by this app (products page), so sharp is genuinely reachable in production. npm's own suggested fix downgrades next to 9.3.3, which is not acceptable. Forcing the patched versions keeps Next intact and takes `npm audit --omit=dev` to zero -- re-check on each Next upgrade and drop these once Next ships patched ranges itself.
comments.shadcn-is-a-devDependency: shadcn is a CLI/scaffolding package; the ONLY thing this app consumes from it is `@import "shadcn/tailwind.css"` in src/app/globals.css, which Tailwind inlines into the compiled stylesheet at BUILD time -- nothing from it ships at runtime. Left in dependencies it dragged @modelcontextprotocol/sdk and @hono/node-server (path-traversal advisory) into the production tree for no benefit. devDependencies is also where tailwindcss itself already lives despite being CSS-imported the same way, so this matches existing precedent. Do NOT remove it outright -- the build fails on the missing CSS import.
